messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

- Wellbutrin XL is used to treat MDD and seasonal affective disorder (SAD).

- Zyban (discontinued) was used to help stop smoking.
- Auvelity (bupropion with dextromethorphan) is used to treat MDD in adults.
- Contrave (bupropion and naltrexone) is used for weight management for specific patients.

The relation 'used for' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug is indicated for the specific purpose or therapeutic use specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

B. 'belongs to drug class': The subject drug is a member of the pharmacological or therapeutic drug class specified by the object entity.
C. 'has dosage form': The subject drug is available in the pharmaceutical dosage form specified by the object entity.
